paragraphs: Rav Zakkai recited before Rabbi Yochanan: Eruvin 9a; Yevamot 77, beginning of side b; Sanhedrin 62a. Yochanan told him, “Go recite outside.” Rabbi Abba raised a contradiction to Rav Yehudah at Rav Zakkai’s winepress: Bava Batra 42b; Eruvin 49a. Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, Kelal Gadol, halakhah 2:Rabbi Zakkai recited before Yochanan …; Yochanan said, “Babylonian, I crossed three rivers ….”
